objective: Reserve an exact Git branch using validated controller-exclusive metadata and the accepted exact-ref command
nonGoals: Defend against code already running as the trusted controller UID
acceptanceCriteria: atomic-ref|WHEN an absent exact branch is reserved|ASSERT TEST_PASS git-reservation-proof
metadata-boundary|WHEN ref parents or object alternates are unsafe|ASSERT ERROR GitReservationError
exact-object|WHEN base is not a SHA-1 commit object|ASSERT ERROR GitReservationError
redirect-defense|WHEN hooks or symbolic refs are prepositioned|ASSERT ABSENT unintended-ref
